business_summary: The Fukushima Bank, Ltd. provides banking products and services in Japan. The company offers car, education, card, housing, apartment, renovation, tax accountant, and business loans, as well as reverse, unsecured, and consolidated plan mortgages; investment trusts; fixed deposits; and insurance products, including pension, life, variable, education, endowment, income protection, health and medical, pet, and automobile. It also provides web transfer acceptance; electronic money and smartphone payment; pay-easy account transfer; ATM; foreign currency exchange; corporate internet banking; cloud deposit and withdrawal management; and bank account transfer data transmission services. In addition, the company leases and purchases construction, machining, transportation, communication, office, home electrical, and medical equipment, as well as precision machinery and others. Further, it is involved in the credit card and credit guarantee activities; development, maintenance, and contracting of computer software; sale, brokerage, and rental of computers and related equipment and consumables; operation and contracting of computer systems; acquisition, holding, and sale of securities; and consulting and business matching services for investment target companies. The company serves individual and corporate customers. The Fukushima Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Fukushima, Japan.
